project: Lumière Skin - AI-Powered Complaint Intelligence Platform

style_guide.global_style: soft glassmorphism, editorial premium beauty-tech, calm and trustworthy, airy whitespace, diffuse lighting
style_guide.global_negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, brand names, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, heavy retouching, oversaturated colors, harsh shadows, clutter, stock-photo cliche, real celebrity likeness
style_guide.notes: Generate original assets only. Do not reproduce the reference portfolio's photos or branding. Subjects should reflect Indonesian users (diverse skin tones, with and without hijab).

assets.usage: Landing hero, behind the glass chat panel
assets.tool_suggestion: CSS radial-gradients (preferred), or Midjourney/Flux for a raster fallback
assets.prompt: Abstract soft mesh gradient background, luminous cyan glow at the top fading into pale lavender and violet at the bottom, large blurred organic blobs, subtle film grain, no objects, no text, smooth and airy, premium beauty-tech website hero
assets.negative_prompt: objects, faces, text, sharp edges, high contrast, banding

assets.usage: Blurred highlight behind the chat input
assets.prompt: Single soft cyan-to-mint radial glow on transparent background, very diffuse edges, 40 percent opacity

assets.usage: AI Analysis section: portrait with scan overlay (add the grid/brackets in SVG)
assets.prompt: Close-up beauty portrait of a young Indonesian woman, natural dewy skin with visible texture, neutral calm expression, soft diffused studio light, clean white seamless background, shoulders visible, head slightly turned, editorial skincare photography, 85mm lens
assets.negative_prompt: heavy makeup, airbrushed skin, filters, jewelry, text
assets.post_processing: Overlay SVG face-mesh grid, corner brackets and dashed connector lines in primary cyan

assets.prompt: Translucent holographic 3D head of a woman wearing a hijab, glass and iridescent material, icy cyan and pale blue tones, soft internal glow, subtle wireframe scan lines on the face, soft gradient background in light aqua, futuristic yet gentle, centered composition
assets.negative_prompt: realistic skin, dark background, horror, harsh reflections, text

assets.usage: Right side of the dashboard greeting banner
assets.prompt: Serene portrait of a young Indonesian woman with eyes closed and a gentle smile, surrounded by soft pastel flowers in violet and white, dreamy diffused light, pastel violet-to-cyan gradient backdrop, high-key editorial beauty photography
assets.negative_prompt: busy background, strong shadows, text, saturated colors
assets.post_processing: Fade the left edge to transparent so it blends into the banner gradient

assets.usage: Ticket detail and dashboard cards (product thumbnails)
assets.prompt: Generic unbranded skincare foaming cleanser tube, white body with a pale cyan cap, minimal label with no readable text, soft studio lighting, subtle shadow, pure white background, product photography
assets.negative_prompt: real brand logos, readable text, clutter, props

assets.usage: Ticket detail and dashboard cards (product thumbnails)
assets.prompt: Generic unbranded skincare serum dropper bottle, frosted glass in pale violet with a white dropper, minimal label with no readable text, soft studio lighting, pure white background, product photography
assets.negative_prompt: real brand logos, readable text, clutter, props

assets.usage: Testimonial carousel (UMKM owners and CS agents)
assets.prompt: Natural portrait of a small business owner in Indonesia in her 30s, warm genuine smile, casual modern clothing, softly blurred workspace with skincare products in the background, natural window light, candid editorial style
variations: woman wearing a hijab, in a small skincare workshop
woman in her 20s, headset on, customer service desk
man in his 30s, brand founder, laptop on desk
assets.negative_prompt: stock-photo pose, overly polished, logos, text

assets.usage: Top bar avatar and CS agent list
assets.tool_suggestion: Midjourney, Flux, or DiceBear as a placeholder
assets.prompt: Friendly head-and-shoulders avatar portrait, Indonesian young adult, soft neutral background in pale lavender, natural expression, consistent lighting across the set
assets.negative_prompt: text, busy background, accessories that hide the face

assets.tool_suggestion: Figma (manual) or Recraft/Ideogram for exploration, then redraw as SVG
assets.prompt: Minimal logomark for a skincare AI brand named Lumière Skin: a stylized droplet merged with a small four-point sparkle, rounded geometry, gradient from cyan to violet, flat vector, centered on a rounded-square, no text

assets.tool_suggestion: Use lucide-react (already compatible); generate custom ones only if needed
assets.prompt: Set of 24 thin-line 1.5px rounded icons, consistent 24px grid: inbox, ticket, sparkle AI, droplet, shield-check, bar-chart, users, settings, bell, search, send, mic, paperclip, clock, flag-alert, check-circle

assets.usage: Hub-and-spoke section: one complaint, fully understood
assets.prompt: Central circular node labelled Complaint Understanding connected by dashed curved lines to five floating chips: Product, Batch Code, Symptom, Severity, Sentiment. White cards with hairline borders, tiny colored dot labels, soft shadows, lots of whitespace
Soft speech-bubble icon containing the letters AI, pale lavender tint on white, subtle inner glow, minimal, flat with a gentle gradient

assets.usage: Oversized cropped brand wordmark in the footer
assets.prompt: Oversized wordmark 'Lumière Skin' in Playfair Display Italic, near-black, 18vw, cropped at the bottom by the viewport edge

assets.usage: Subtle noise over gradients to prevent banding
assets.tool_suggestion: Generate procedurally (SVG feTurbulence) or any noise PNG
assets.prompt: Seamless fine monochrome film grain noise tile, low contrast, tileable

assets.tool_suggestion: Figma using the generated assets above
assets.prompt: Composite cover: cyan-to-violet mesh gradient, centered serif headline 'Turn complaints into insight', glass dashboard card preview, brand logomark top left, generous whitespace
